sections.section_title: RAMCFG memory 2 ECC single error address register (RAMCFG_M2SEAR)
sections.text_helper: Section 5.6.5 "RAMCFG memory 2 ECC single error address register (RAMCFG_M2SEAR)" in chapter 5 (RAMs configuration controller (RAMCFG)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 120.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x04C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 ESEA[31:0]: ECC single error address
When the ALE bit is set in RAMCFG_M2CR, this bitfield is updated with the address
corresponding to the ECC single error.
